name: community/compress
description: DEFLATE and what is built on it: the zlib codec with its buffers and stream readers/writers, raw inflate, gzip, and the move-to-front and OZip3 experiments beside them.
residual: Vendored from minia2 source/ on 2026-08-27, when std stopped carrying it (docs/STDLIB.md there). The sources also stay in minia2 source/: dropping them would break the full A2 build and widen the diff against vanilla ETH, so this is a second copy on purpose and `upstream` names the first one.
This is what ZIP and PNG stand on, so it comes out of std before lib/archive and lib/gui can follow.

excludes.BWHCompressor: imports NextPrime, which is in lib/numbers and not published yet; a Burrows-Wheeler/Huffman experiment with no user in the tree
